title: Living room, Istanbul apartment
description: A lived-in living room (salon) of a 1990s Istanbul apartment, about 4.5 x 5 m, ceiling 2.7 m. Beige walls, light oak laminate parquet, a red-and-cream kilim-style rug, white PVC double windows with sheer white tulle curtains and grey side drapes, a white steel panel radiator under the window. A three-seat grey fabric sofa with two patterned cushions faces the TV wall. A low walnut coffee table holds a tray with tea glasses and a bowl of fruit.

objects.vitrin: a tall freestanding glass-front display cabinet (vitrin), dark walnut wood, 190 cm tall and 110 cm wide, two glass doors and glass shelves crowded with tulip-shaped tea glasses, porcelain plates and crystal bowls, standing free against the right wall with a visible gap behind it and no wall bracket or strap
objects.tv: a 65-inch black flat-screen TV standing on its pedestal feet on top of a low white TV console, no wall mount, no strap, the screen turned off and dark
objects.bookcase: a tall narrow white bookcase, 200 cm tall, next to the TV console, packed with books, with two heavy ceramic vases and a stack of large books placed on its very top
objects.mirror: a large heavy mirror in an ornate gilded frame, about 120 x 80 cm, hanging on a single wire from one nail high on the wall directly above the sofa
objects.chandelier: a multi-arm brass chandelier with glass shades hanging on a chain from the ceiling directly above the coffee table
objects.dresser: a low oak dresser near the window with a clearly visible white nylon anti-tip strap screwed from its back edge into the wall
objects.door: the open white interior door to the hallway, the doorway clear
